# `PluginManifest::from_str`

<span class="sdk-badge sdk-badge-manifest">manifest</span> <span class="sdk-kind">method</span>

Source: **Manifest** (`src/plugins/manifest.rs`). Generated group: **Methods**.

```rust
fn from_str (value : & str) -> Result < Self , PluginContractError >
```

## SDK Example

_Source: [`examples/methods/pluginmanifest-from-str.md`](../../examples/methods/pluginmanifest-from-str.md)_

```rust
let manifest = PluginManifest::from_str(r#"
id = "flux.demo"
display_name = "Flux Demo"
version = "1.2.3"
api_version = 4
dll = "bin/flux_demo.dll"
configs = "config"
assets = "assets"
content = true
"#).expect("manifest should parse");
assert_eq!(manifest.id.as_str(), "flux.demo");
```
